Qew: What a splendid, mischievous little mystery she is. Never satisfied with the veneer of a project or a person, and forever the cheerful optimist, Qew is very adept at seeking and searching for those hidden little corners of humour, life or intelligence. She loves being surprised by things. Boys love her too, although her independence might scare a few of them off, initially.
Quentin: She shares her male counterpart’s intelligence and unusualness, except that she is so ideally happy within herself and her world that she almost belies belief. Quentin is amazing. She would have made an excellent grief counsellor.
Quill:
Dripping with heartbreak? Had your innards torn out by the deeds, deceit or dastardly actions of another? You better go on over to Quill’s house. She may not be able to cure you but she’ll at least help with the first step. She’s sensual, she’s happy and she’s an optimist. In fact, go over and say hello even if you’re fine. 
The End.
Quin: As Quinn’s close cousin she shares similar traits: she’s thoughtful, she looks more serious than she is and her long and languid frame is admired from afar my many, but this one is better at finding her passions and making them happen. We have no idea how or why one letter can make such a difference.
Quinata: The fact that Quinata did well at school and then went on to university was no surprise to anyone. The free-wheeling artistic life was never quite her, although had she attempted it she probably would have been quite successful there also. What you may not hear is Quinata orgasming from a mountain top. Then again...
Quinn: Quinn is softer than her male counterpart but is she a sensitive loner? Do still waters run deep or do they just sit there? Just be a little mindful here everyone, for Quinn might take some time to get to know.
